notes.title: A New Type of Zombie
notes.content: Hello everyone, we have added a new type of zombie. We hope you enjoy playing!

notes.title: Game updates
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We've received a lot of player feedback recently. Based on this, we're implementing the following updates:
1.Added grenades for the Human faction. Grenades not only deal high damage but can also knock back Mutants.
2.Fixed a bug causing abnormal AI behavior for Humans.
3.Improved the brightness in Chase Mode maps.

notes.title: Game Release Notice
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]The game [b]<[/b]RESIST MUTANTS[b]>[/b] has officially launched. We welcome any suggestions or feedback in the comments section. We will regularly update the game content to provide you with a better gaming experience.[/p]
